title: Microsoft 365 Purview eDiscovery Administration — Content Search, Cases, Holds & Export
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft 365 Security administration).

Security & Compliance / Purview eDiscovery PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Run Microsoft 365 eDiscovery end to end — search, hold, review, export
problem: Legal and investigation requests demand defensible eDiscovery across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams — and ad-hoc content searches don't hold up. This solution operates Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Content Search and keyword/condition query design, eDiscovery (Standard) cases and holds, and eDiscovery (Premium) custodians, review sets, analytics/de-duplication, and export — with a defensible, repeatable workflow. (Scoped to eDiscovery/search/hold/export — distinct from Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, and retention.)
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the eDiscovery model: Content Search vs Standard vs Premium, cases, holds/custodians, review sets, analytics, and export — and how it differs from Purview DLP/labels/retention.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensing for Standard/Premium, eDiscovery Manager/Admin roles, in-scope workloads, legal stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — design searches (KQL, conditions), create cases + holds/custodians, build and review a review set, run analytics/de-dup, and export defensibly — pilot-first, each case/search named; determinations deferred to legal.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance / Graph PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (search scoped, holds effective, export complete + defensible) plus Best Practices; legal/records determinations deferred to legal.
short: Operate Microsoft Purview eDiscovery — Content Search, Standard cases + holds, and Premium custodians/review sets/analytics/export — a defensible, repeatable workflow across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
